steps.content: You trail after Keylan, your thoughts still clouded and your steps unsteady.

You blink hard and glance down. Beneath your feet, the asphalt with its faded crosswalk lines is cracking open, pried apart by stone slabs. Thick, dark fluid oozes through the gaps and seeps around the edges of your shoes.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Maria City's assimilation rate with the Reflection Plane... fifty-four percent...

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Ah!
[24 Quick Cut to the Surface World - Distortion + White Flash]

Light detonates in front of you, ripping the world clean in two. On one side, the broken remains of Maria City; on the other, the forest of steles from the Void of Yin. A blinding white seam sizzles where they meet.
From that seam, the phantoms begin to pour through, one after another.
They are nothing like ordinary ghosts. Dark cyan mist seeps from the holes in their forms, and though no sound escapes, every wound seems to scream.

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>To receive is to render. To seek is to owe... Your wish has been granted... But ours... what of ours?!</color><i>

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Has he paid the price? Has he paid the price? He has...</color><i>
steps.female_content: <i><color=#7683a2>Has she paid the price? Has she paid the price? She has...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>But that doesn't count! Not yet paid... still not enough... not enough...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Give us... give us... Pay your price!</color><i>
You drop hard onto your knees, palms sinking into the black ooze.
They crowd in, a mass of tangled forms passing through each other, their fingers clawing at the fissures between the emerging stone slabs, creeping nearer and nearer.
You. Only you. They're here for your life alone.

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2><b>Give us... give us what must be paid...

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2><b>Bones, blood, your name... any of it will do...

steps.speaker: Voices of the Phantoms
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2><b>Give it to us! Give it to us!

One hand presses to your chest, cold fingers burrowing into your skin. Another climbs the nape of your neck, twisting into your hair and pulling your head back hard. You can see only the grey sky hanging over Maria City now.
Beneath you, the ground goes soft and yielding. Your pulse thuds in your ears. Beat by beat. Heavier and slower each time.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: They've crossed over again... Xiansheng!
[White flash, then rescue CG]
A blast of sword wind shoots past your ear from behind. You have no time to turn before something wrenches you back with brutal force.
It's Chengxiao's hand, clamped around your collar, dragging your whole body clear of the grasping phantoms.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: His <color=#fb9259>price</color>... has it not already been...
steps.female_content: Her <color=#fb9259>price</color>... has it not already been...

steps.content: The black fog freezes in place, its wild churn suddenly still. But only for a breath. Stung into rage, it comes roaring back, rushing at Chengxiao from every direction at once.
